title: notice_effect.determined payload (v1)
description: Wire payload of `notice_effect.determined` - the only notice event that can carry `establishes_legal_effect: true`. Supporting attempts appear as a COUNT; the attempt ids stay in the audit snapshot, so a consumer that needs to re-examine the evidence must come back through an authorized read rather than reconstruct it from a broadcast. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
